original_question: James pipi 6 zaidi ya Robert. John ana pipi mara mbili zaidi ya za Robert. Ikiwa John ana pipi 54, John ana pipi ngapi zaidi ya James?
question_template: {name_male_1, James}  pipi {num_digit_1, 6} zaidi ya {name_male_2, Robert}. {name_male_3, John} ana pipi {num_text_1, mara mbili} zaidi ya za {name_male_2, Robert}. Ikiwa {name_male_3, John} ana pipi {num_digit_2, 54}, {name_male_3, John} ana pipi ngapi zaidi ya {name_male_1, James}?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_2 - num_digit_2/f1 - num_digit_1  # f1 is the numeric value of num_text_1
